pages.text: $(bold)Drops$(): 1x $(item)shulker shell$(), with a 25%% chance plus 10%% per Looting level for one additional shell.$(br)

In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Shulker$() is spawned using the life energy of a $(#ad03fc)Cube Mob$() and immediately possessed by the summoned $(#ad03fc)Afrit$(). The $(#ad03fc)Possessed Shulker$() will always drop at least one $(item)shulker shell$() when killed. Minecraft 1.12 does not include the modern $()
projectile-based Shulker multiplication mechanic, so this entity cannot create normal Shulkers that way.$(br)
